studies.title: The Babylonian Map of the World
studies.caption: A clay tablet shows Babylon on the Euphrates inside a ring of 'bitter river', with far islands beyond where the sun is never seen.
studies.prompt: Close archaeological-style oblique study of a small buff clay tablet about600BCE on a scribal work surface. Its upper portion carries tiny wedge marks, lower portion a circular double-ring world diagram with a river through the central land and triangular regions outside. Stylus and thumb convey scale, no modern continents, no modern globe.
